note: Fire glow for the story's globe: Argentina's side of the planet, each month of 2025, as NASA's MODIS camera (Aqua) saw it. Half-degree squares; each month is a list of number triples (a, b, v): west edge lon = (a - 184) / 2, south edge lat = (b - 116) / 2, v = ceil(255*sqrt(x/100)) where x = lit 5 km squares per sending day in the half-degree square; squares with v under 12 are left out. Cut from the Hot-Spot Clock's globe file (built from NASA FIRMS MODIS C6.1).
